title: Two Harnesses, One Score
briefMd:
# Two Harnesses, One Score

Same frozen 40-ticket set. No live model calls — the playground scores two **already-recorded** harness traces:

| Harness | Setup | Headline |
|---|---|---|
| **A** `bare` | no wrapper · seed 1 | **28/40 (70.0%)** |
| **B** `fewshot` | 3-shot wrapper · seed 2 | **31/40 (77.5%)** |

B looks like a +7.5 pp ranking win. At grade time we recompute accuracy and **95% Wilson intervals** on the frozen predictions.

Pass (class A) when you call the delta **noise**, not a model win, and you name the reason as **CI overlap** or **seed/wrapper** — not “B is a better model”. Wall-clock is information, not a gate.

rankingCall.description: Is the headline accuracy delta a ranking win?
